scope: GC28: finite nested DIRECT-array capture DAGs under an authenticated active real Closure root; arrays may share children and direct captures.
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; LC_ALL=C; TZ=UTC; tests/semantics/profile.json
rule: Capture and entry lists must be DIRECT and defined. Existing heap_reach computes the component with visited identities, preserving all edge occurrences. Every reached array is allocated, mutable, nonproxy, outside pooled reach and has equal ordinary/physical children; every reached object is an allocated childless stdClass. Self-reach from each array child list rejects direct cycles. An array-to-array edge restricted to capture reach makes this clause disjoint from flat admissions. Actual source/caller/root, capture arity, static-cell and hidden-table fences remain. Collector owner, trial-root, buffer and count algorithms are unchanged.
engine_basis: Pinned Zend get_gc/array iteration exposes every repeated zval edge, while mark/scan visits identities by color. Pure direct array nesting from ordinary by-value PHP operations is a DAG: zend_compile_expr_with_potential_assign_to_self preserves RHS snapshots and SEPARATE_ARRAY duplicates shared tables. The Closure hidden capture table remains black under the genuine caller root; no arbitrary Closure-cycle or hidden-table count is granted.
